name: Mercure Living Putrajaya
short_description: A 299-unit serviced-apartment tower in Putrajaya connected to the Shaftsbury retail complex and Alamanda Shopping Mall, open since July 2022.
ai_summary: Mercure Living Putrajaya opened on 1 July 2022 as a 299-unit serviced-apartment tower spread across 36 floors in Precinct 1, connected to the Shaftsbury retail complex and within walking distance of Alamanda Shopping Mall. Every unit is apartment-style with a full kitchenette, washer and dryer, and separate living area, aimed at longer-stay guests, government-business travelers, and families rather than a typical overnight hotel stay, alongside a 52-metre outdoor saltwater pool, gym, tennis court, and spa. Guest reviews are generally positive for the spacious apartment-style rooms and convenient dual-mall location, though a subset of reviews flag inconsistent cleanliness in common areas and breakfast quality the hotel has said it's working to address.

pros: 299 apartment-style units across 36 floors, each with a full kitchenette, washer, and dryer
Connected to the Shaftsbury retail complex and walkable to Alamanda Shopping Mall
52-metre outdoor saltwater pool, gym, tennis court, and spa on site
Spacious layouts suited to families or longer government-business stays
Complimentary parking, a notable convenience for guests driving in from Kuala Lumpur or KLIA
cons: Some reviews flag inconsistent cleanliness in common areas
Breakfast quality has drawn mixed feedback, which hotel management has acknowledged and said it's addressing
research_highlights: The spacious, apartment-style rooms with full kitchens draw consistent praise, especially for families and longer stays
Its dual-mall location -- Shaftsbury and Alamanda -- is repeatedly highlighted as a strong convenience
Complimentary parking is called out favorably by guests arriving by car
research_watchouts: A subset of reviews describe cleanliness lapses in shared spaces
Breakfast quality concerns appear in multiple reviews, with management response acknowledging the feedback

faqs.question: Does Mercure Living Putrajaya have kitchens in the rooms?
faqs.answer: Yes -- every one of its 299 units is apartment-style with a full kitchenette, fridge, microwave, and cooking utensils, plus a washer and dryer, making it geared toward longer stays and families rather than a typical short hotel visit.

faqs.question: When did Mercure Living Putrajaya open?
faqs.answer: It opened on 1 July 2022 as a 36-floor serviced-apartment tower in Putrajaya's Precinct 1, connected directly to the Shaftsbury retail complex and within walking distance of Alamanda Shopping Mall, Malaysia's federal administrative capital's main shopping hub.
